title: fix(driver-turso): refuse media column move planning on the remote face instead of answering "nothing to move"
body:
Fixes #19894

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

A remote `TursoDriver` now refuses `planMediaColumnMove()` with the transport's `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` / 501 envelope instead of answering an empty scan. `os migrate files-to-references` reports that refusal as a column step it could not judge, beside its full backfill, verify and flag report, instead of printing "nothing to move".

## Why `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` and not the claim's `no`

The claim (comment 5819382636) carries `Clause-②: no`, set for the driver-only surface. H2 below put the command file in scope, and the command's `--json` document gains one key, `columnMoveRefused`. This repo reads a new `--json` key as a clause-② widening: `.changeset/17080-per-release-spec-changes.md` declares "`Clause-②: yes (widening)` — … plus one new `os validate --json` key". The driver refusal is the narrowing. A diff that widens one surface and narrows another is the `yes (narrowing)` combination `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs` names. Both packages are graded `minor`, so the level axis and the ADR-0087 gate hold under either reading. The seat decides which line stands; if it is `no (narrowing)`, the changeset line changes with it.

## What changed

- `packages/drivers/driver-turso/src/turso-driver.ts`: a `refuseRemoteMediaColumnMove()` builder, the same shape as the four sibling remote refusals, and a `planMediaColumnMove()` override. The remote face refuses. The local and replica faces call `super` unchanged. The constructor guard, `detectMode` and `toKnexConfig` are untouched.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/files-to-references.ts`: `runColumnStep` catches a planner throw whose `code` is `StandardErrorCode.enum.NOT_IMPLEMENTED`. It returns a stated skip, `driver_cannot_plan`, carrying `{ error, code }` built by `errorCodeFields`. Any other throw is re-thrown to the outer `catch`, as before. The text face prints one `Column step: NOT JUDGED` warning that carries the driver's message. `--json` gains `columnMoveRefused`, which is `null` unless the driver refused. The exit code stays the self-check's, as it already is for the command's other column-step skips (`runColumnStep`'s own docblock: "a deployment whose driver cannot plan a column move is not a deployment whose backfill failed").
- Two pins and a changeset (`@objectstack/driver-turso` and `@objectstack/cli`, both `minor`; BREAKING banner; `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`).

## Measurements (tree `61609edf8`, this branch's base)

**H1: confirmed.** A table `m` with `doc: file` and `pic: image`, synced on the transport's SQLite-backed double. On each remote door the physical columns were `id, created_at, updated_at, title, doc, pic`, all TEXT.

| face | door | `managedObjectFields` | placeholder `hasTable('m')` | scan |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| local `:memory:` | `initObjects` | `m` | true | 2 `unquote` plans |
| replica | `initObjects` | `m` | true | 2 `unquote` plans |
| remote | `syncSchemasBatch` | empty | false | `{ plans: [], refusals: [] }` |
| remote | `syncSchema` | empty | false | `{ plans: [], refusals: [] }` |
| remote | `initObjects` | empty | false | `{ plans: [], refusals: [] }` |

`mediaFields` read `{ m: [doc, pic] }` on every remote door. The planner walks `managedObjectFields` and probes through the placeholder, and either one alone empties the answer.

**H2: the command misreported a driver refusal, so the command file is in scope.** Measured on the base command with this PR's CLI doubles, a planner that throws `NOT_IMPLEMENTED`:

- `--apply --yes --json`: exit 1, and stdout was the error alone: `{"error":"Planning the media column move is not supported by this transport.","code":"NOT_IMPLEMENTED"}`. There was no backfill, verify or `flag` key, although `runFilesToReferencesMigration` records the flag before the column step runs. There was no status either: `errorCodeFields` forwards `httpStatus`, and the driver stamps `status`.
- `--apply --yes`, text face: exit 1. Only the header, the boot line and one error line printed: no backfill report and no "deployment flag recorded" line.
- The pre-fix remote answer, an empty scan: exit 0, and the text face printed "Column step: nothing to move — this datastore declares no single-value media column." In `--json`, `columnMove` was `null`.

**H3: confirmed and reused.** `turso-driver.ts` at base has four `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` / 501 refusal builders: autonumber, transaction, deferred DDL and drift detection. This one copies their shape. It adds no new code.

**H4: a remote `TursoDriver` cannot reach the moved state.** `fileColumnsMoved` is set in exactly two places: the constructor, from `SqlDriverConfig.fileColumnsMoved`, and `resolveFileColumnsMoved()`. `toKnexConfig` builds the base config from fixed keys and forwards no `fileColumnsMoved` on any arm. `resolveFileColumnsMoved()` is called only from `SqlDriver.initObjects`, which none of the three remote doors calls. Measured with a stand-in resolver that answers `true`: `setFileColumnsMovedResolver` returned `true` (taken), and on every remote door the resolver was asked 0 times. `fileColumnsMoved` stayed `false`. A remote write of `file_abc` stored `"file_abc"` (the JSON encoding) and read back as `file_abc`. The `SqlDriverConfig.fileColumnsMoved` docblock names this posture as the intended fail-toward: "A host outside that path … simply never resolves it and stays on the JSON arm, which is again the correct fail-toward." This PR stops the one in-repo route that could have stamped `columns_moved_at` through a remote datasource, which is this command's column step. Whether a remote database can hold that stamp by an out-of-band route, such as one imported from a moved local file, was not measured. No finding filed; see Acceptance notes.

**H5: no in-repo doc, skill or example tells an operator to run the command against a remote Turso database, and none describes `nothing_to_move`.** Searches at `61609edf8`, over `content/docs`, `skills`, `docs`, `examples` and `.claude/skills`:

- `files-to-references`: 10 files. Of these, 4 also mention turso or libsql. In each of the 4 the mention is outside the command's section: `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` in its `os serve` / `os start` flag tables, and `types.mdx`, `releases/v17/17-0.mdx` and the QA checklist in unrelated lines. The positive control is `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`, which lists the command (lines 955 to 965).
- `nothing_to_move` or "nothing to move": 0 hits. Positive control: 6 hits in `packages/cli/src`.
- `columnMove`, `columnsMovedAt` or "column step": 1 hit, in ADR-0104 line 1272, which is about boot refusal and not this output. Positive control: `columnsMovedAt` has 1 hit in `packages/cli/src`.
- turso or libsql on the same line as `os migrate`: 2 hits, both unrelated (a removed turso config key and the `mongo` driver-id rename). Positive control: 65 `os migrate` lines in `cli.mdx`.

No doc documents the command's `--json` key set, so the new key needs no doc edit.

## Verification (HEAD `672da75c7`)

- **driver-turso**: `typecheck` exit 0. It compiles test files: its first run caught a TS2339 in the new pin, now fixed. `vitest run`: 63 files, 1417 tests passed.
- **New driver pin** `turso-remote-media-column-move-refusal.test.ts`, 9 tests. The controls: `:memory:` and `file:` local faces equal a plain `SqlDriver` scan of the same declaration, and the replica face plans 2 `unquote` moves. The remote refusal runs on all three doors, with the media columns asserted on disk. It asserts `code`, `status`, the first sentence, and that no statement was sent. A last pin checks the encoding sentence the refusal ends with.
- **Driver ablation** via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, on the guard line. Anchor 1 to 0, blob `9919ee7a80bd` to `b4b6eb8df1b1`. The 3 remote cases went red with `expected a refusal, got an answer: {"dialect":"sqlite","plans":[],"refusals":[]}`, which is the pre-fix answer. The 6 other cases stayed green. Restore was proven: blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The subject resolves through the relative `./turso-driver.js` import, so no `dist/` is in the path.
- **CLI**: `typecheck` exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit`, then `check:test-typecheck` OK with the debt ledger unchanged). The unit layer ran 224 files, with 3129 tests passed and 29 skipped. 2 files failed only on a prerequisite, "packages/cli is not built (./dist/index.js is absent)". After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build`, those 2 files plus the new pin ran green: 3 files, 34 tests. The integration layer is declared to CI. The diff touches no integration-tier file and no spawn entry, and the new pin is unit-tier: it mocks `bootSchemaStack` through `vi.hoisted` and value-imports no driver package.
- **New CLI pin** `files-to-references.column-step-refusal.test.ts`, 5 tests, end to end through `MigrateFilesToReferences.run`. It covers the exit code and `--json` for `--apply --yes --json` and for the dry run, plus the text face. Controls: an empty scan still reads "nothing to move" and has `columnMoveRefused: null`. A throw without a capability code still exits 1 with `{"error":"connection reset","code":"ECONNRESET"}`.
- **CLI ablation** on the `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` catch line, anchor 1 to 0: the 3 refusal cases went red (exit 1, the pre-change shape), the 2 controls stayed green, and the restore was proven.
- **Gates**: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `672da75c7` derived 64 commands. All 64 exit 0. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-coverage` and `check:i18n-walk-parity` first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, workspace not built) and were re-run green after the build. `--ran`: "✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 64 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 64 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 64 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)."
  - `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`: "✓ check-adr-0087-registration: 1 declared-breaking changeset(s), each carrying an ADR-0087 disposition." The changeset is read as `[BREAKING+clause-②-narrowing]`, `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.
  - `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main`: "✓ This diff introduces no `major` bump." Its level axis reads "NOT APPLICABLE" locally, with no `pull_request` payload; see the `--event` run below.
  - `check:driver-conformance`, before (at `61609edf8`) and after: "OK — 50 covered cell(s), 0 in the DEBT ledger, 0 exempt."
  - The diff-scoped `node scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs --base 61609edf8`: "✅ check-issue-citations: every citation this change adds resolves".
  - `pnpm check:error-code-casing`: "✓ no unlisted lowercase error codes in 6509 scanned file(s) (ADR-0112)."
- **Lint** was narrowed to the 4 changed `.ts` files with `eslint --no-inline-config --format json`: 4 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. The population is eslint's own: `--print-config` resolves a config for each file, and none reports "File ignored". This narrowing cannot move any untouched file's verdict, because `eslint.config.mjs` enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, no typed rules; its own comment says so). The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- NOT MEASURED locally, and owned by CI: the path-scheduled jobs (Test Core shards, Temporal Conformance, Dogfood, Build Core) and the workspace type-check lanes.

## Acceptance notes

- **Why the refusal does not point at the local or replica transport** (the suggested route asked for that, like the siblings). Moving a local SQLite copy does not move the remote database. For a remote database that did hold moved columns, H4 measured that the remote face keeps writing the JSON encoding. Whether an embedded replica's column step reaches the primary was not measured. So the message says what the remote datasource keeps, and names no remedy that was not measured.
- **README left untouched.** It documents none of the four sibling remote refusals, and adding only this one would be partial. Separately, line 25 of `packages/drivers/driver-turso/README.md` lists `RemoteTransport: beginTransaction, commit, rollback`, while the remote face refuses all three with `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` / 501 (`refuseRemoteTransaction`). That is reported to the seat as a finding and not changed here.
- **Observation, not filed**: `errorCodeFields` forwards `httpStatus` and drops `status`, so a driver refusal reaching any CLI `--json` error envelope carries its `code` without a status. The new `columnMoveRefused` uses the same helper, which keeps it consistent with the command's own error envelope.
- **Observation, not filed**: any other throw after the backfill of an `--apply` run still takes the outer `catch` and replaces the report with the error. This PR leaves that path as it was. There is no named reproduction of a non-refusal throw at that point.
- **H4 posture, not filed**: the remote face takes the engine's ADR-0104 resolver and never asks it. That is the documented fail-toward, and after this PR no in-repo command can stamp a remote database as moved.
